text: To test an idea, the model has to risk being wrong. It needs a number, a range, or a distinctive pattern that a measurement can miss. And the result must point back to the idea, rather than leave several possible causes. Lana found one clean numerical test in the family she surveyed. It uses neutron stars, the ultra-dense collapsed cores of exploded stars. The ones we can time as they spin are called pulsars, and their mass can be measured.
